notes: Published community parameter tables; not compared to a local game executable.

Per-level armor uses the published base plus per-level parameter increment, with physical attribute scaling applied separately. Hollow Soldier armor uses the separately published wiki reinforcement rows.
Agility and i-frames use the investment table, including hidden tiers with identical displayed agility.
Flynn and base Chloranthy have conflicting published descriptions. This model follows the combat research formulas (Flynn maximum-load curve; Chloranthy 15%).
Northern Ritual Band +1 uses the corroborated 35% HP reduction, correcting the combat spreadsheet’s contradictory 25% formula.
